project_overview.description: Pay-per-performance creator & clipping marketing platform in Indonesian language. Brands post campaigns with Rp per 1K views rate, min views, total budget, and rules. Creators submit video links (TikTok, IG Reels, Threads, YouTube Shorts), earn money based on views, build daily check-in streaks, and withdraw funds (min Rp 50.000) to bank/e-wallet accounts.

design_concepts_and_probabilities.description: High-contrast energetic warm orange (#FF5500) paired with slate obsidian (#0F172A) and clean sand white (#FAFAFC). Bold Indonesian typography, pill status chips, fiery daily streak counters, marquee payout ticker, and tactical data cards.
Monochromatic dark/light grey grid base with signal orange functional highlights, tight bento grid, and structured editorial typography.
Thick black borders, playful badge chips, high contrast drop shadows, and vibrant youth-focused gamification elements.
Frosted glass panels, ambient glow backdrops, and floating 3D social media icons.

component_guidelines.test_id_rules: MUST include data-testid attribute on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, filter chips, cards, modals, table rows). Standard format: kebab-case role-based (e.g. data-testid="submit-video-button", data-testid="withdraw-modal-trigger", data-testid="campaign-card-1").
component_guidelines.shadcn_customization: Customized Radix UI primitives with warm orange (#FF5500) accents, heavy rounded borders (rounded-xl / rounded-2xl), and dark mode compatibility.
component_guidelines.toast_notifications: Use Sonner toast component located in src/components/ui/sonner.js for instant user feedback (e.g., 'Video link berhasil disubmit!', 'Permintaan penarikan Rp 100.000 diproses').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as background gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts or simplistic uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky header and modals.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always specify exact properties like transition-colors or transition-transform.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or crisp sharp borders with scale-95 active press animations).
NEVER use generic AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖, 🧠, 💭, 💡, 🔮, 🎯 for UI icons. Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) or custom SVG icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, click scales, badge pulses, and smooth entrance transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than default. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, selection states, and custom loading skeletons separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes for robust automated testing.
